_help: Edit this file with Notepad, save it, then restart the server. In paths use forward slashes, e.g. C:/pkTriggerCord/pktriggercord-cli.exe

_notes.cli_path: MUST BE SET: full path of pktriggercord-cli.exe (it sits in the same folder as the pkTriggerCord program you already use).
_notes.camera_model: Leave empty = first Pentax camera found. Only fill in (e.g. K-5II) if several cameras are connected.
_notes.camera_device: Leave empty. Only needed if auto-detection fails: the camera's drive letter on Windows, e.g. E
_notes.raw_format: DNG or PEF. DNG is the safest. NOTE: pkTriggerCord switches the camera to RAW-only with this format.
_notes.default_iso: ISO used when N.I.N.A. does not set a gain. In N.I.N.A. the 'Gain' field IS the ISO value (e.g. 3200).
_notes.iso_min / iso_max: Allowed ISO range shown to N.I.N.A. (ASCOM gain must stay below 32768).
_notes.aperture: Empty = leave the camera/lens setting alone. For electronic lenses (DA/FA) you can force e.g. 4.0 here.
_notes.exposure_max_s: Longest exposure offered to N.I.N.A. (max 30; Bulb mode is not supported).
_notes.pixel_size_um: Pixel size in micrometres. N.I.N.A. uses it with your focal length for plate solving. K-5 II = about 4.8
_notes.sensor_width / sensor_height: K-5 II = 4928 x 3264. The script warns you if the real frames differ.
_notes.bayer_pattern: auto = taken from the RAW file. Override with RGGB, BGGR, GRBG or GBRG only if colours look wrong.
_notes.scale_to_16bit: true = 14-bit camera data is shifted to the 16-bit range like most astro cameras (MaxADU 65535).
_notes.focal_length_mm: Only used to print the pixel scale and write the FITS header in --test-shot. N.I.N.A. uses its own telescope profile.
_notes.server_port: TCP port of this server. Change only if it is already used (the program tells you).
_notes.bind_address: Keep 0.0.0.0, otherwise N.I.N.A.'s automatic discovery cannot reach the server.
_notes.enable_discovery: Answer ASCOM Alpaca discovery broadcasts (UDP 32227) so N.I.N.A. finds the camera by itself.
_notes.connect_timeout_s: How long pktriggercord-cli may wait for the camera to answer.
_notes.shot_timeout_margin_s: Extra seconds (on top of the exposure) before a hung pktriggercord-cli is killed and an error is reported.
_notes.pause_between_shots_s: Minimum pause between two camera accesses.
_notes.keep_raw_dir: Folder (forward slashes) where a copy of every DNG/PEF is kept - for debugging. Empty = off.
_notes.simulate: true = no camera, synthetic star fields (same as 4b_start_server_SIMULATION.bat).
